from __future__ import annotations

from tilefoundry import func
from tilefoundry.dsl import Tensor
from tilefoundry.dsl.storage import rmem, smem
from tilefoundry.dsl.tf import *  # noqa: F401, F403
from tilefoundry.ir.types.shard import B, Layout, Mesh, Topology

@func(mesh=Mesh((Topology("cta", 136),), Layout((17, 8), (8, 1)), names=('x', 'y')))
def gemm(
    a: Tensor[(2176, 8192), "bf16"],
    b: Tensor[(1024, 8192), "bf16"]
) -> Tensor[(128, 128), "bf16", ((128, 128), (128, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), "rmem"]:
    result = zeros(type=Tensor[(128, 128), "bf16", ((128, 128), (128, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), "rmem"])  # Tensor[(128, 128), "bf16", ((128, 128), (128, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), "rmem"]; memory traffic=rmem:r0/w32.00KB@logical,r0/w32.00KB@total,r0/w32.00KB@cta operands=result:r0/w32.00KB
    for mi in tile(128 * mesh.x, (128 * mesh.x) + 128, 128):
        for ni in tile(128 * mesh.y, (128 * mesh.y) + 128, 128):
            for ki in tile(8192, 64):
                v1 = a[mi, ki]  # Tensor[(128, 64), "bf16"]; memory traffic=rmem:r16B/w0@logical,r16B/w0@total,r16B/w0@cta operands=0:r0/w0;1:r16B/w0;result:r0/w0
                v2 = reshard(v1, layout=((128, 64), (64, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), storage=smem)  # Tensor[(128, 64), "bf16", ((128, 64), (64, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), "smem"]; memory traffic=gmem:r16.00KB/w0@logical,r16.00KB/w0@total,r16.00KB/w0@cta;smem:r0/w16.00KB@logical,r0/w16.00KB@total,r0/w16.00KB@cta footprint=a:272.00KB operands=0:r16.00KB/w0;result:r0/w16.00KB
                v3 = b[ni, ki]  # Tensor[(128, 64), "bf16"]; memory traffic=rmem:r16B/w0@logical,r16B/w0@total,r16B/w0@cta operands=0:r0/w0;1:r16B/w0;result:r0/w0
                v4 = reshard(v3, layout=((128, 64), (64, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), storage=smem)  # Tensor[(128, 64), "bf16", ((128, 64), (64, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), "smem"]; memory traffic=gmem:r16.00KB/w0@logical,r16.00KB/w0@total,r16.00KB/w0@cta;smem:r0/w16.00KB@logical,r0/w16.00KB@total,r0/w16.00KB@cta footprint=b:128.00KB operands=0:r16.00KB/w0;result:r0/w16.00KB
                v5 = matmul(v2, v4, a_layout="MK", b_layout="NK")  # Tensor[(128, 128), "bf16", ((128, 64), (64, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), "smem"]; memory traffic=smem:r32.00KB/w32.00KB@logical,r32.00KB/w32.00KB@total,r24.00KB/w16.00KB@cta operands=0:r16.00KB/w0;1:r16.00KB/w0;result:r0/w32.00KB
                v6 = reshard(v5, layout=((128, 128), (128, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), storage=rmem)  # Tensor[(128, 128), "bf16", ((128, 128), (128, 1), {mesh.x @ B()}), "rmem"]; memory traffic=rmem:r0/w32.00KB@logical,r0/w32.00KB@total,r0/w16.00KB@cta;smem:r32.00KB/w0@logical,r32.00KB/w0@total,r16.00KB/w0@cta operands=0:r32.00KB/w0;result:r0/w32.00KB
                result = v6
            result = result
        result = result
    return result
